title: Cosmic Mind Crystal Ball
description: A large ornate crystal ball sits on a metallic stand in a surreal purple landscape. Inside the glowing sphere, a purple silhouette of a human head with a yellow tree-like nervous system faces a large green eye with multiple smaller eyes and a pink smile, surrounded by cosmic elements.
prompt: Surreal scene featuring a large glowing crystal ball on an ornate metallic stand in a purple flower field with a lone explorer figure holding a staff. Inside the transparent sphere, a purple human head silhouette shows a yellow branching nervous system and tree roots, facing a large stylized green eye with multiple smaller eyes, pink lips, and cosmic patterns. Background shows purple mountains, planets, and chalk-like drawings on a dark cosmic backdrop with geometric shapes and stars.
